title: classroom50-progress publish knobs
description: Per-classroom configuration. Lives at <classroom>/publish.json. This file is edited by humans; the publish workflow reads it to decide whether and what to publish.

$schema.description: Pointer to this schema, e.g. ../schemas/publish.schema.json. Enables editor validation and autocomplete.

enabled.description: Master switch. false = classroom is excluded from the workflow matrix: no collection, no page data refresh, hidden from the classroom list. Existing data files are left untouched.

title.description: Display name shown on the page and in the classroom list (e.g. a course abbreviation). Defaults to the directory name.

mode.description: past-due: show assignments whose deadline has passed (locked assignments are always skipped). explicit: show only the slugs listed in 'assignments'.

assignments.description: explicit mode: assignment slugs to publish, e.g. ["regex-basics"]. Ignored in past-due mode.

exclude_students.description: Usernames never shown on the page (e.g. dropped students). Staff roles on the roster are excluded automatically.
